Enterprise WebRTC RFC 5104 / RFC 4585 PLI/FIR Storm & Audio Preemption Guard
Eliminating 60KB Video Keyframe BUNDLE Queue Stalls on 20ms Opus Voice & Orphan Layer-Switch Loops
🎉 STAGE 460 · 100TH TOPIC MILESTONE
463 Dims · 923 Guards · 932 Probes
❌ Unguarded Multimodal BUNDLE: 60KB I-Frame Stalls Voice
1. Unthrottled RTCP PLI / FIR Keyframe Micro-Burst Starving Voice
• Retransmitted FIR (same SeqNr) or 50ms PLI flood triggers back-to-
back 60KB (480kbit) video keyframes (1,000x larger than 60B Opus).
• On a 2Mbps link, 3 unpaced keyframes clog the shared BUNDLE FIFO
for 720ms → starving 20ms Opus voice packets into robotic freeze!
Result: 240–720ms Voice Queueing Stalls During Multimodal Video Loss
2. RFC 4585 trr-int NACK Starvation & Mid-GOP Orphan Layer Switch
• Misconfigured a=rtcp-fb trr-int > 1000ms suppresses urgent audio
RTCP NACK recovery reports across the entire RTT window.
• SFU switches SVC/Simulcast layers mid-GOP without checking RFC 9626
Decode Target boundaries → triggers self-reinforcing PLI cascades!
Result: Starved Audio Packet Recovery & Self-Inflicted PLI Cascades
✅ RFC 5104 Cooldown Guard (P913) & AVPF trr-int Guard (P914)
P913 · RFC 5104 FIR Dedup, Audio Preemption & [1000, 5000]ms Guard
• Deduplicates repeated 8-bit FIR Command Sequence Numbers in 0ms.
• Grants 60B Opus voice packets strict priority preemption over video.
• Clamps minimum inter-keyframe cooldown to [1,000, 5,000]ms (2,000ms)
with paced keyframe slicing (0 keyframe-induced voice stalls)!
clampedUnthrottledKeyframeStormOrAudioStarvedBursts = 0 · Cooldown ∈ [1000, 5000]ms
P914 · RFC 4585 AVPF trr-int [50, 500]ms & Decode-Target Sync Guard
• Clamps a=rtcp-fb trr-int regular feedback interval to [50, 500]ms.
• Exempts urgent audio RTCP NACK packets for immediate transmission.
• Enforces RFC 9626 Dependency Descriptor decode-target boundary
alignment before switching SFU video layers (0 orphan frames)!
clampedStarvedAudioNackOrOrphanLayerSwitches = 0 · trr-int ∈ [50, 500]ms
